Locate the digit cards (arrange_largest_number).
<python>
if 'start' in globals():
    start('B', 'pick check')
r = locate('yellow digit')
objs = sorted(r['objects'], key=lambda o: o['position'][0])
print(len(objs), [(o['id'], [round(v, 3) for v in o['position']]) for o in objs])
</python>

Pick every card with the nearer arm and set it back where it was.
<python>
for o in objs:
    arm = 'left' if o['position'][0] < 0 else 'right'
    p = pick(arm, o['id'])
    print('PICK', o['id'], arm, p['ok'], str(p.get('reason'))[:60], str(p.get('check'))[:70])
    if p['ok']:
        q = release(arm, x=o['position'][0], y=o['position'][1])
        print('RELEASE', q['ok'], get_state()['step'])
</python>
